assets.description: On June 9, 2026, verified host win11-50-10-7 (10.50.10.7) generated 20 events tied to 2 malvertising/adware domains linked to the Vane Viper network (2plyr.com and ptoamtoucoay.com), indicating likely browser redirect or push-notification abuse under user Dhwani Shah. Investigate the endpoint and browser for unwanted extensions/notification permissions and review why 10 connections to 2plyr.com were not blocked while ptoamtoucoay.com was blocked.
